posts.body:
:::sample
Sample text · shows the reading typography · replaced from the CMS
:::

Every system eventually wakes someone at night. The question this layout answers is how a long piece of writing reads here: generous measure, quiet colour, and room for the occasional aside.

Headings, quotes and code each get their own treatment, so an essay can move between reflection and implementation without changing voice.

:::margin
Side notes sit in the margin on desktop and drop in after their paragraph on mobile.
:::

## The dichotomy of control

> "Some things are within our power, while others are not."
> — Epictetus · Enchiridion 1

Code blocks sit on a dark plate in the monospace face, with the language noted like a museum label.

```yaml
alert: api_latency_p99
within_control: [runbook, rollback, comms]
outside_control: [upstream_provider]
```

## Runbooks as virtue

Images, inline links, lists and footnotes follow the same rules, so anything written in the CMS editor lands here looking finished.

***
